Through strategic partnerships with industry leaders Bombora and LeadSift, we enrich our first-party intent insights to ensure your GTM efforts are precisely targeted and highly efficient, maximizing your ROI. Predictiv helps B2B teams turn buyer intent into real pipeline by activating the right accounts, channels, and buying committees at the right time. Powered by unified opportunity signals and first-party execution, we help you turn unseen potential into measurable growth through content syndication, email marketing, programmatic advertising, and appointment setting.

about_short_description.short_description: Predictiv Data transforms your strategy with unified buyer intent insights, helping you connect with the right prospects at the right time.

product.name: Revenue Activation Framework
product.description: A four-step AI-driven process that unifies multiple data signals to identify, prioritize, and engage high-value B2B revenue opportunities across the full buying committee.

product.name: 3x Intent Model
product.description: A scoring system that combines first-party and third-party intent data from three sources to provide a unified, ranked signal of buyer readiness for sales and marketing teams.

product.name: Unified Revenue Opportunity Signals
product.description: A data integration service that consolidates firmographic, technographic, demographic, and behavioral intent data into a single actionable view for B2B revenue teams.

product.name: Full-Funnel Campaign Execution
product.description: In-house execution of multi-channel marketing campaigns including content syndication, email marketing, programmatic display, and appointment setting to engage entire buyer committees.

product.name: B2B Buyer Data and Insights
product.description: Provision of clean, compliant B2B contact and company data enriched with intent and technographic insights to support sales and marketing strategies.
